stories.title: Multiplexed node-pore sensing for high-throughput, label-free single-cell detection
stories.takeaway: Four encoded microfluidic channels enable parallel electrical detection of single cells without fluorescent labels.
stories.what_happened: A four-channel node-pore sensing device used distinct Manchester-coded channel signatures; a structural classifier identified channels with 99.3% accuracy across 1,480 labeled transit events.
stories.why_it_matters: Parallel, label-free cellular phenotyping could expand throughput for microfluidic bioengineering and eventual tissue-model assays.
stories.caveat: Channel identification was stronger than resolving multi-channel coincidences; mechanical phenotyping and clinical deployment remain future work.

stories.title: A microfluidic fluorescence lifetime screening platform bridges in vitro and in vivo formats and enables discovery of Amyloid β aggregation inhibitors
stories.takeaway: A nanoFLIM platform uses a shared fluorescence-lifetime sensor to compare amyloid aggregation across cell-free, cellular and organism models.
stories.what_happened: Researchers developed microfluidic fluorescence-lifetime screening and tested 445 compounds, identifying a candidate that inhibited amyloid-β self-assembly in several experimental formats.
stories.why_it_matters: Comparable readouts across model complexity may improve early-stage therapeutic screening and reduce assay translation gaps.
stories.caveat: Pilot screening and model-organism effects do not establish efficacy or safety in people with Alzheimer's disease.

stories.title: miProbe: microbial peptide repository of biological embeddings
stories.takeaway: An open microbial peptide resource provides more than one billion sequences and precomputed embeddings for computational discovery.
stories.what_happened: miProbe aggregates approximately 1.08 billion microbial peptides across habitats and supplies 8 TB of protein-language-model embeddings and APIs for peptide mining.
stories.why_it_matters: The platform could accelerate investigation of understudied microbial functions and discovery of candidate bioactive peptides.
stories.caveat: Computational embeddings and predicted functions are not equivalent to experimentally demonstrated biological activity.

stories.title: A hierarchical metabolic flux orchestrates cell cycle transitions in bacteria
stories.takeaway: Cell-cycle progression in Caulobacter crescentus depends on temporally changing metabolic flux and cytosolic redox state.
stories.what_happened: Genetic perturbations and metabolic-flux tracing linked fatty-acid synthesis and reverse versus forward TCA flux to distinct redox states during bacterial cell-cycle transitions.
stories.why_it_matters: Connects microbial metabolic state with proliferation and highlights possible future targets for antimicrobial research.
stories.caveat: The mechanism was studied in a specific bacterial model and has not been shown to generalize to gut species or human pathogens.

stories.title: Multiparametric assessment of TNNI3 variant phenotypes in human iPSC-cardiomyocytes correlates with disease severity in patients
stories.takeaway: A human iPSC-cardiomyocyte assay combines contractility and calcium measurements to assess genetic variants against clinical phenotypes.
stories.what_happened: Researchers quantified functional responses to cardiac troponin-I variants and related variant clusters to disease onset in a patient cohort.
stories.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the value of combining human cell models with multidimensional functional measurements for disease modeling and variant interpretation.
stories.caveat: Single-center clinical correlations need external replication; this work also appeared as a 2025 preprint.
